Stake delegation pool and map management with update, remove, refresh, query, and iteration functions.

# Purpose
`fd_stake_delegations.c` implements the storage and access logic for a stake delegation table. It defines a container object, `fd_stake_delegations_t`, that owns two internal data structures: a pool of `fd_stake_delegation_t` records and a chained map keyed by `stake_account`. The file provides the memory layout helpers [`fd_stake_delegations_align`](<#fd_stake_delegations_align>) and [`fd_stake_delegations_footprint`](<#fd_stake_delegations_footprint>), plus lifecycle functions [`fd_stake_delegations_new`](<#fd_stake_delegations_new>), [`fd_stake_delegations_join`](<#fd_stake_delegations_join>), [`fd_stake_delegations_leave`](<#fd_stake_delegations_leave>), and [`fd_stake_delegations_delete`](<#fd_stake_delegations_delete>) to create, attach to, detach from, and destroy the container in caller-managed memory.

The file also provides the main data operations for stake delegation records. [`fd_stake_delegations_update`](<#fd_stake_delegations_update>) inserts or updates a delegation entry, [`fd_stake_delegations_remove`](<#fd_stake_delegations_remove>) deletes an entry or marks it as a tombstone, [`fd_stake_delegations_refresh`](<#fd_stake_delegations_refresh>) rebuilds the table from stake account data in `fd_funk`, and [`fd_stake_delegations_query`](<#fd_stake_delegations_query>) returns a delegation by stake account. [`fd_stake_delegations_cnt`](<#fd_stake_delegations_cnt>) reports the number of used pool entries, and the iterator functions [`fd_stake_delegations_iter_init`](<#fd_stake_delegations_iter_init>), [`fd_stake_delegations_iter_next`](<#fd_stake_delegations_iter_next>), [`fd_stake_delegations_iter_done`](<#fd_stake_delegations_iter_done>), and [`fd_stake_delegations_iter_ele`](<#fd_stake_delegations_iter_ele>) provide sequential access to the active map entries.
